canonical_statement: The study sought to compare the composite of all-cause mortality and hospitalization after initiation of empagliflozin versus dapagliflozin in patients with heart failure.

canonical_statement: The study was a multicenter retrospective cohort study using deidentified electronic medical record data from the TriNetX Research Collaborative Network of 81 health care organizations, primarily in North America.

canonical_statement: Propensity scores for empagliflozin versus dapagliflozin initiation were estimated by logistic regression using all selected covariables; continuous laboratory measures and ejection fraction were represented as categorical indicators.

canonical_statement: The study used 1:1 greedy nearest-neighbor propensity score matching without replacement, defining post-match similarity as an absolute standardized mean difference below 0.1.

canonical_statement: Matched-group outcomes were compared with Kaplan-Meier methods and log-rank tests, with hazard ratios, 95% confidence intervals, and absolute risk differences reported; censoring occurred the day after the last fact in the TriNetX record.
